svg.font-family: 'Source Code Pro', ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, monospace
svg.aria-label: The four special cases in the MSEQ clock loop — transport start, clock dropout, a large persistent phase excursion, and a wrong tempo hint — plus the deliberate timing offset that the loop holds rather than corrects.
svg.text: What the loop does when things go wrong
A gentle nudge is right for noise and wrong for a genuine jump. Four cases get
their own answer; everything else is left to the ±1 ms trim from figure 4.
Ableton hits play
on FA, then on the first F8
Reset both counts and place tick 0 at once,
then snap onto the first real tick when it
lands — Live sends it about 101 ms after the
FA, because its clock runs ahead of its
audio. One step, not a slow slide into place.
The clock stops arriving
no input for more than 3 output ticks
Coast: keep emitting at the last trusted rate
and keep counting, so the position is still
right when it returns. It never quietly
becomes a free-running metronome, and 1250 ms
of silence still trips the patch's
all-notes-off alarm.
Something jumped
|error| > 4 periods for 6 ticks
A transport jump, or a tempo change during a
dropout, is a real discontinuity: fix it in
one step rather than leaning on the loop for
a bar. Checked once per output tick, so a
stall and its burst — one scheduler slice —
cannot trigger it.
The tempo number is wrong
off by > 3 BPM for 24 ticks
The tempo hint travels a different path from
the clock and can go stale. After a 48-tick
grace it is dropped in favour of the measured
rate. Real case: the hint sat at 138 while
the master ran 140, and later 136.
offset: -250 to +250 ms, held as part of the target
Live transmits its clock early by the audio output latency, about 115 ms, so that an external
synth's returning audio lands on the grid. There is one knob and two possible targets — that
audio on the grid, or the MIDI Ableton records — so MSEQ makes it a setting. The loop treats it
as where it is meant to be, never as an error to remove.
Every threshold here is a constant in backend/clock_discipline_core.lua, unit-
tested against a synthetic tick stream that reproduces stalls, bursts and steps.
